2610.03084.title: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
2610.03084.paper_summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are judged by benchmarks that measure whether requested content appears, but these benchmarks largely overlook the complementary ability to satisfy negated constraints, for example, generating "a non-red cup." Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks and requires careful prompt and evaluation design. We introduce NegT2IBench, a benchmark of 4,800 prompts covering two attribute types and four relation categories. Prompts are organized by polarity: the number of positive statements that must hold and negated statements that must not, each ranging from 0 to 2. Varying the two independently separates the effect of negation from the effect of prompt complexity. Our detector-based scoring is reproducible, auditable, and pinpoints which requirement failed. On 600 images with three-annotator labels, it agrees with humans as closely as vision-language judges up to 30x larger, while using only a fraction of their GPU memory. Across eleven T2I models and 211,200 images, nine score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one. Per-statement scoring reveals that the loss is largest for color and near zero for proximity, and that 41.5% of failed statements render exactly what the prompt forbids. Rendering what a prompt asks for and withholding what it forbids are distinct capabilities that an aggregate compositional score cannot distinguish. NegT2IBench measures the latter directly, providing a controlled testbed for diagnosing negation failures and developing methods to overcome them.
2610.03084.paper_summary_zh: 文本到圖像（T2I）模型的評估依賴於衡量請求內容是否出現的基準，但這些基準在很大程度上忽視了滿足否定約束的互補能力，例如生成「一個非紅色的杯子」。衡量否定提出了與基於肯定的基準不同的挑戰，並需要仔細的提示和評估設計。我們引入了NegT2IBench，這是一個包含4,800個提示的基準，涵蓋兩種屬性類型和四種關係類別。提示按極性組織：必須成立的正面陳述數量和必須不成立的否定陳述數量，各自範圍從0到2。獨立變化這兩者將否定的影響與提示複雜性的影響分開。我們的基於檢測器的評分是可重複的、可審計的，並且能夠精確指出哪一項要求未達標。在600幅圖像上，使用三位標註者的標籤，其結果與人類的評價相當接近，甚至比視覺-語言評判者的結果小30倍，同時僅使用其GPU記憶體的一小部分。在十一個T2I模型和211,200幅圖像中，九個模型在單一否定陳述上的得分低於在單一正面陳述上的得分。逐陳述評分顯示，顏色的損失最大，而接近度的損失幾乎為零，並且41.5%的失敗陳述恰好呈現了提示所禁止的內容。呈現提示要求的內容和隱藏提示禁止的內容是兩種不同的能力，綜合的組合得分無法區分這兩者。NegT2IBench直接測量後者，提供了一個受控的測試平台，用於診斷否定失敗並開發克服這些失敗的方法。
